info.name: CrownBid Employee API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for CrownBid endpoints accessible to the **empleado** (employee/operator) role.

There is no separate admin JWT role: all `/api/admin/*` routes use `requireEmployeeAuth`.

Import `employee-api.postman_environment.json` and run **Auth → Employee Login** first.

item.name: 1. Auth
item.description: Employee authentication. Client login endpoints are public but not employee workflows.

request.description:
Authenticates an employee using `EMPLOYEE_ADMIN_EMAIL` / `EMPLOYEE_ADMIN_PASSWORD` from API `.env` and a row in `dbo.empleados`.

**Response 200:** `{ accessToken, employeeId, email, role: "empleado" }`

**Errors:** 401 invalid credentials, 422 validation

item.name: 3. Auctions
item.description: Create/update via admin routes. Public reads via optional auth. Close item is employee-only.

request.description:
Creates a new auction. Employee-only (`requireEmployeeAuth`).

**Schedule rules:** start must be in the future and at least 10 calendar days ahead; `horaFin` after `hora`; duration 15–240 min.

**Response 201:** auction summary with `id`. Invalid schedule returns **400** (does not crash the server).
